# couchbase-capella_outbound_private_endpoint_service_verification (Data Source)

Checks a customer's private link service from the cluster's cloud account and region before an outbound private endpoint is created to it. Nothing is created. A failed check is reported in `checks` with `ready` false rather than as an error, so a configuration can gate on `ready`. `provider_config` is set only once the service is found, and only for the cluster's cloud. GCP and Azure have no fields yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella_outbound_private_endpoint_service_verification" "service_check" {
  organization_id = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  project_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  cluster_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  service_name    = "com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0123456789abcdef0"
}
```
